fields.name: command
fields.coerce: tested for truthiness, compared with `==`, then read with `.startsWith` and `.split(" ")`. A truthy value that is not a string throws at `.startsWith` (Failure row 3)
fields.description: The mainframe terminal on the `cyberland` map. The commands are in the Notes. When it is falsy, the handler skips the mainframe part.

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: Mainframe only. With it, you also get a `game_response` with the result (success or failure).

fields.name: pass
fields.description: Admin only. When it is correct, the server runs `code`.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Admin only: JavaScript that the server runs. The server sends nothing back.

responses.name: Mainframe answer
responses.when: A mainframe command ran. It goes to every client whose view holds (0, -100) on `cyberland`, so you get it only when you are near that point.

fields.name: message
fields.description: The answer: see the commands in the Notes.

confirm.note: Every answer is a literal in the handler

responses.name: Result
responses.when: A mainframe command ran. Sent after `chat_log`, only when the request has `request_id`.

fields.name: authorized
fields.description: `false` only for an unknown command (the `UNAUTHORIZED` answers).

fields.name: reply
fields.description: The answer, the same as `message` of the `chat_log`.

responses.name: Admin code
responses.when: `pass` equals `keys.ACCESS_MASTER`: the server runs `code` with `eval` and sends nothing back.

failures.intro: Rows 1 to 3 apply only when `command` is truthy. A failure ends the handler, so `code` does not run either.

confirm.note: Without `request_id` the handler returns and sends nothing; live, a socket with no character got no reply

rows.when: You are not on `cyberland`, or you are dead.
`command` is truthy but not a string, and not loosely equal (`==`) to `"hello"` or `"give"`. `.startsWith` throws.
Admin part: `pass` is wrong or absent. The server does not run `code`. This is the usual end of a mainframe request.

also.when: `"give spares"` with items in `S.misc.spares`: after the `chat_log`, `drop_one_thing` makes a `chest1` with the spares at (1, -88) on `cyberland`. Then the list is empty.

fields.name: items
fields.description: How many item stacks the chest holds (`drop.items.length`). The spares are `electronics` and `networkcard`, which stack, so it is 1 or 2.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The chest id, 30 random characters. Send it with `open_chest`.

confirm.live_needed: The spares list is live state (`S.misc.spares`, which the cyberland timer grows at random every 10 s or so, node/server_functions.js:2866-2895): whether it holds anything, and so whether `drop` comes, depends on the server.

order: `"give spares"` with spares only: `drop` to you
